__doc__: Caption styles for the clip pipeline. 'base' is the Outset house style (one-line, cream serif, red active-word highlight); its font defaults to Georgia (EB Garamond fallback on non-macOS). Each platform override layers on top of base, changing ONLY the fields it names — set 'font' (an absolute path or a repo-relative fonts/<x>.ttf) here to give a posting spot its own typeface. Precedence at render time: SHORTS_<FIELD> env var > platform override > base > built-in default. Select a platform with SHORTS_PLATFORM (youtube | linkedin | x | youtube_longform); unset = base only. Format (aspect ratio) is a separate axis: SHORTS_FORMAT.
